ref: Solution of a quadratic equation by completing the square SolvedEx.1
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
solution:
It is convenient to make coefficient of \(x^2\) as 1 and then convert the equation as the difference of two squares, so dividing the equation by 5,

we get, \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x - \dfrac{3}{5} = 0\)

now if \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x + k = (x - a)^2\) then \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x + k = x^2 - 2ax + a^2\).

compare the terms in \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x\) and \(x^2 - 2ax\).

\(-2ax = -\dfrac{4}{5}x\)   \(\therefore\) \(a = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{4}{5} = \dfrac{2}{5}\)

\(\therefore\) \(k = a^2 = \left(\dfrac{2}{5}\right)^2 = \dfrac{4}{25}\)

Now, \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x - \dfrac{3}{5} = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 - \dfrac{4}{5}x + \dfrac{4}{25} - \dfrac{4}{25} - \dfrac{3}{5} = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(\left(x - \dfrac{2}{5}\right)^2 - \left(\dfrac{4}{25} + \dfrac{3}{5}\right) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(\left(x - \dfrac{2}{5}\right)^2 - \left(\dfrac{19}{25}\right) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(\left(x - \dfrac{2}{5}\right)^2 = \dfrac{19}{25}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x - \dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{\sqrt{19}}{5}\) or \(x - \dfrac{2}{5} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{19}}{5}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = \dfrac{2}{5} + \dfrac{\sqrt{19}}{5}\) or \(x = \dfrac{2}{5} - \dfrac{\sqrt{19}}{5}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = \dfrac{2 + \sqrt{19}}{5}\) or \(x = \dfrac{2 - \sqrt{19}}{5}\)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{2 + \sqrt{19}}{5}\) and \(\dfrac{2 - \sqrt{19}}{5}\) are roots of the equation.

(The book's side note : when an equation is in the form \(x^2 + bx + c = 0\), it can be written as \(x^2 + bx + \left(\dfrac{b}{2}\right)^2 - \left(\dfrac{b}{2}\right)^2 + c = 0\), that is \(\left(x + \dfrac{b}{2}\right)^2 = \left(\dfrac{b}{2}\right)^2 - c\).)

ref: Solution of a quadratic equation by completing the square SolvedEx.2
subtopic: Solving by Formula and Completing the Square
solution:
Method I : Completing the square.

\(x^2 + 8x - 48 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 8x + 16 - 16 - 48 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \((x + 4)^2 - 64 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \((x + 4)^2 = 64\)

\(\therefore\) \(x + 4 = 8\) or \(x + 4 = -8\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = 4\) or \(x = -12\)

Method II : Factorisation

\(x^2 + 8x - 48 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 12x - 4x - 48 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x(x + 12) - 4(x + 12) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \((x + 12)(x - 4) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x + 12 = 0\) or \(x - 4 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -12\) or \(x = 4\)
